ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the diagram is a schematic diagram of the Harbin-Dalian High-Speed Railway, in which cities such as “Harbin” and “Dalian” are marked, and rivers, mountains, cities, and high-speed railway lines are shown with a legend; the high-speed railway line roughly connects from Harbin in the north southward to Dalian, indicating that this is the Harbin-Dalian High-Speed Railway located in the Northeast region of China. Then combine the materials: the Harbin-Dalian High-Speed Railway is a high-speed railway in a high-cold region; along the line, the extreme minimum temperature in winter is about minus 40°C, the maximum snow depth is 30cm, and the maximum soil freezing depth reaches 205cm. Low temperature and deep freezing can cause frost heave in the roadbed soil, thereby affecting the track smoothness and operating safety of the high-speed railway. Therefore, the main technical difficulty overcome during its construction process was roadbed frost heave.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像，确认图示线路是从哈尔滨到大连的哈大高铁，位于东北高纬、高寒地区。再读材料中“高寒地区”“冬季极端最低温度零下40°C左右”“最大积雪厚度30cm”“土壤最大冻结深度达205cm”等信息。把这些信息与冻土工程规律连接：低温和深冻结会使路基土体冻胀，影响高速铁路轨道平顺和安全。因此作答为“路基冻胀”。
